title: GPU Runway & Churn 7-Day Forecast (regional pool supply model)
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet estimates short-term GPU supply runway across regional pools (NA / EU / APAC) using a churn + arrival model. Intent: surface immediate risk windows, quantify burst budget remaining, and propose quick mitigations for the next 7 days.

Assumptions and model notes:
- Churn: daily scheduled deallocations + spot expiration modeled as 1.8% of pool size per day baseline (historical median).
- New supply arrivals: scheduled capacity additions from reservations or cloud credits applied; variable by region.
- Average effective capacity = Allocated GPUs * (1 - fragmentation factor). Fragmentation factor set to 6% baseline, increases under microbursts.
- Headroom target: 12% for user-facing SLOs. Anything under 6% triggers immediate mitigation.
- Projected demand change: derived from route-level traffic telemetry and queued job growth (7-day trailing rate).
- Runway definition: days until headroom < 6% under projected demand growth and expected churn.

Summary table (snapshot 2026-12-01; projected through 2026-12-07):
Date | Region | Cluster (example) | Pool | Allocated GPUs | Effective GPUs | Avg Util % | Headroom % | Net daily churn (GPUs) | Scheduled inflow | Projected demand delta (%) | Runway (days)
2026-12-01 | NA | na-cluster-3 | batch-highprio | 320 | 301 | 74 | 9 | -6 | +0 | +4% | 4.8
2026-12-01 | EU | eu-cluster-a | interactive | 210 | 197 | 81 | 5 | -5 | 0 | +8% | 2.6
2026-12-01 | APAC | apac-1 | reserved-prod | 160 | 150 | 69 | 14 | -3 | +8 | +2% | 9.3
2026-12-02 | NA | na-cluster-3 | batch-highprio | 314 | 295 | 76 | 7 | -7 | 0 | +6% | 3.9
2026-12-02 | EU | eu-cluster-a | interactive | 205 | 192 | 83 | 3 | -6 | 0 | +12% | 1.7
2026-12-02 | APAC | apac-1 | reserved-prod | 157 | 147 | 71 | 12 | -4 | +8 | +3% | 8.1
(…rows intermixed to 2026-12-07)

Interpretation highlights:
- EU interactive pool is the tightest: headroom drops below the 6% threshold by 2026-12-03 in the baseline forecast due to persistent demand uptick on chat routes and a higher-than-typical churn (recent instance failures causing retries).
- NA batch-highprio has short runway but is more salvageable via short-term burst credit and small reserved shifts (see actions).
- APAC reserved-prod remains healthy because of a scheduled inflow (+8 GPUs/day) from a committed cluster add-on starting 2026-12-02.

Scenario sensitivity (simple):
- Surge scenario (+40% demand spike for 6 hours/day): EU interactive runway collapses to <1 day, NA drops to ~1.5 days, APAC remains >4 days.
- Conservative decay (-10% demand): all regions pass the 12% headroom target within 72 hours.

Quick mitigations (ranked):
1) Soft-preempt: identify long-running low-priority slices in NA batch pools and preempt 12 GPUs (owner: Marcus) — expected immediate headroom +3–4%.
2) Burst pool enable (ops): enable ephemeral burst nodes for EU interactive for next 48 hours (owner: Diego) — target +20 GPUs warmup — reduces P50 latency risk.
3) Deflake: triage the retry patterns causing churn in EU (SRE + runtime) — short-term throttle to reduce ghost allocations (owner: Priya).
4) Reserve reassignments: shift 10 GPUs from APAC dev-reserve to EU for 36 hours (requires approval; owner: @infra-allocations).

Action table / owner tracker:
Action | Owner | ETA | Expected impact
Preempt low-prio slices (12 GPUs) | Marcus Lee | 2026-12-01 18:00 UTC | headroom +3.5% NA
Enable EU burst nodes (warmup) | Diego Ramos | 2026-12-01 20:00 UTC | +20 GPUs EU
Open incident to investigate churn | Priya Singh | 2026-12-01 16:00 UTC | reduce churn by ~50% over 24h
Approval for reserve shift | @infra-allocations | 2026-12-02 09:00 UTC | +10 GPUs EU temporary

Open questions / uncertainties:
- Fragmentation model may undercount ephemeral fragmentation under sustained microbursts — sensitivity +3–5% effective loss not captured in baseline.
- Scheduled inflows depend on partner provisioning (cloud credits) and can slide; fallback plans required if inflow delayed >24h.
- Model does not yet incorporate per-model KV-cache memory pressure — separate follow-up recommended for large-chat routes.

Next steps:
- Apply preempt action and enable EU burst nodes immediately (owners assigned above).
- Re-run forecast every 12 hours until EU headroom recovers >8% or scheduled inflow completes.
- Expand model to include KV-cache pressure and add a fragmentation multiplier driven by 1-minute telemetry.

Notes to reviewers:
- This is an operational forecast sheet (quick-turn). Please add comments inline with exact timestamps for any approval decisions.
- If you disagree with churn baseline, attach alternate churn series (historic daily churn csv) to the linked artifacts.

- Utilization by cluster: /internal/telemetry/gpu/cluster-util (query: avg_token_util_5m)
- Scheduled inflows: infra-allocations calendar (shared)
